results.attack: Payment payload bound to different payment requirements than the ones charged
results.expectation: A payload whose accepted requirements differ from the quoted requirements must be refused by Inntris before a facilitator is consulted.

results.attack: Signed EIP-3009 authorisation diverges from the accepted requirements it is presented with
results.expectation: An Inntris ALLOW should attest that the payment actually signed pays the approved recipient the approved amount.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at FACILITATOR_VERIFY by facilitator:compliant (invalid_exact_evm_payload_recipient_mismatch). permissive facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xpermissive.
results.notes: Every policy field is derived from `accepted`; `payload` is bound only as an opaque hash. The archetype of a borrowed check: the compliant facilitator rejects it, the permissive one settles it, and no Inntris check participates.

results.attack: Payment payload attached only after the decision was issued without one
results.expectation: The settled action must be byte-identical to the authorised action, including the presence or absence of a payload binding.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: ACTION_HASH_MISMATCH, DECISION_BINDING_MISMATCH). permissive facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: ACTION_HASH_MISMATCH, DECISION_BINDING_MISMATCH).

results.attack: Recipient substitution (payTo redirected to an attacker address) — requested directly

results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_PREFLIGHT by inntris-policy (verdict BLOCK). permissive facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_PREFLIGHT by inntris-policy (verdict BLOCK).

results.attack: Recipient substitution (payTo redirected to an attacker address) — swapped in after a legitimate authorisation
results.expectation: The guard refuses to settle an action that differs from the authorised one, without relying on the facilitator to notice.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at FACILITATOR_VERIFY by facilitator:compliant (invalid_exact_evm_payload_recipient_mismatch). permissive facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: ACTION_HASH_MISMATCH, DECISION_BINDING_MISMATCH, PAYMENT_REQUIREMENTS_MISMATCH).
results.notes: Under the documented order the facilitator sees the swapped requirements first, so the compliant run attributes the rejection to FACILITATOR_VERIFY. The permissive run shows the guard rejecting the same swap independently.

results.attack: Amount substitution via declared asset precision (assetDecimals supplied by the caller)
results.expectation: The decimal amount policy evaluates should be derived from the asset, so an atomic amount cannot be rescaled below a limit.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xtx. permissive facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xpermissive.
results.notes: Atomic 150000000 is BLOCKed as 150.00 at assetDecimals=6 and ALLOWed as 0.15 at assetDecimals=9. Decision, action hash and requirements hash are mutually consistent in both cases, so no verifier downstream can detect the rescaling.

results.attack: Expired authorisation (decision presented after its expiry)
results.expectation: An expired decision must not settle, and the refusal must not depend on the facilitator.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: DECISION_EXPIRED). permissive facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: DECISION_EXPIRED).

results.attack: Nonce replay (one decision presented for a second, different execution)
results.expectation: A consumed decision must not settle again under a new execution reference, without relying on facilitator idempotency.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED). permissive facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED).

results.attack: Settlement replay with no execution reconciliation store, the guard's default
results.expectation: Replaying a settled payment must never invoke the settlement executor a second time.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xtx. permissive facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xpermissive.
results.notes: An idempotent nonce consumption is treated as success, and with reconciliationStore undefined nothing else stands between that answer and a second settlement.

results.attack: Settlement replay with the same execution reference, reconciliation configured
results.expectation: A completed settlement must not be re-executed when the attacker reuses the execution reference.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: EXECUTION_ALREADY_COMPLETED). permissive facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: EXECUTION_ALREADY_COMPLETED).

results.attack: Insufficient balance (payer cannot fund the quoted amount)
results.expectation: A payer without funds should not have the resource released. Inntris holds no balance state, so this is expected to be facilitator-owned; the run measures whether anything else stops it.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at FACILITATOR_VERIFY by facilitator:custom (insufficient_funds). permissive facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xpermissive.
results.notes: Balance is not observable to the adapter. Recorded as BORROWED rather than PASS because no Inntris check contributes to it.

results.attack: Settlement executed without a preceding facilitator verification
results.expectation: The guard should make verify-before-settle structurally unavoidable, so an integration cannot settle an unverified payment.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xtx. permissive facilitator: NOT REJECTED: resource released, transaction 0xpermissive.
results.notes: settleIfAuthorised accepts an opaque executor and has no facilitator seam, so an integration that omits verification settles regardless. The facilitator here would have rejected the payment had it been asked.

results.attack: Insufficient balance surfacing only when settlement is attempted
results.expectation: A settlement that fails after being attempted must not release the resource and must leave an operator-visible unresolved record.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at FACILITATOR_SETTLE by facilitator:custom (InntrisGuardError: EXECUTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN)

permissive.not_expressible: The permissive stand-in never fails settlement, so a settlement-time funding failure cannot be produced against it.

results.attack: Settlement failure with no execution reconciliation store, the guard's default configuration
results.expectation: A settlement failure should carry an Inntris reason code and leave a durable unresolved record regardless of configuration.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at FACILITATOR_SETTLE by facilitator:custom (SettlementFailure: Settlement failed: insufficient_funds)

permissive.not_expressible: The permissive stand-in never fails settlement, so a settlement-time funding failure cannot be produced against it.

results.notes: Second face of F-2. With reconciliationStore undefined the raw executor error propagates uncaught out of settleIfAuthorised: no InntrisGuardError, no reason code, and no unresolved operation for an operator to reconcile. The caller is left to interpret a bare facilitator error.

results.attack: Facilitator verifies the payment, then settlement fails or times out
results.expectation: An unknown settlement outcome must not release the resource, must not retry automatically, and must leave a durable record.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: EXECUTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN)

permissive.not_expressible: The permissive stand-in always settles successfully, so the attack premise cannot be produced against it.

results.attack: Repeated resource access using a single paid authorisation
results.expectation: One authorisation must yield at most one settled access, without relying on the facilitator.
results.observed: compliant facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED). permissive facilitator: rejected at INNTRIS_POST_VERIFY by inntris-guard (InntrisGuardError: NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED).

results.attack: Agent identifier carried into the receipt but not evaluated by policy
results.expectation: An agent identifier named in a signed decision should either constrain the decision or be documented as informational.
results.observed: Changing agent_id changes the action hash and the receipt but not the verdict. evaluatePolicy never reads agent_id; the local policy schema has no per-agent rule.
results.notes: The KYA OS gate binds agent identity on its own path. This concerns the plain x402 path only.

results.attack: Provenance of agentId
results.expectation: Every field reaching a decision, hash or receipt is classified by source, controllability and validation.
results.observed: reaches [action-hash, receipt]; source client-asserted; attacker-controllable yes; validated against NOTHING on the local policy path. Carried into the receipt; evaluatePolicy never reads it. The KYA gate binds it separately on the KYA path only.

results.attack: Daily cumulative limit keyed on a caller-supplied principal identifier
results.expectation: A cumulative spending limit should be keyed on an identity the caller cannot choose.
results.observed: principal_id is taken from the caller on the library path and from the request body on POST /v1/decisions/evaluate. spendDayKey uses it directly, so each distinct value carries its own independent daily total.
results.notes: Severity depends on who may call the endpoint; see D8. On the KYA path the principal is derived from the presentation instead.

results.attack: Fields bound into the receipt that no policy rule evaluates
results.expectation: A field carried into a signed receipt should either be evaluated by policy or be documented as decorative.
results.observed: scheme=deferred and maxTimeoutSeconds=86400 produced a valid, signed ALLOW. The scheme reaches protocol_reference and the requirements hash; no policy rule references either field.
results.notes: A reader of the receipt may reasonably infer that a named scheme was approved as such. It was not evaluated.
